title: The Mapuche people and the Wallmapu: reporting what each side says
goal: Report what the Mapuche, the state and the courts say about land and history, using según and verbs of saying.
grammar: reported statements and sources with según and decir que (known), applied to the Mapuche

items: I can report who says what with *según* and *dice que* when a subject is disputed.
I can say who the Mapuche are and what the Wallmapu is.
I can use the new words for Mapuche culture and for land claims.
